page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.16xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the arm64 ARMv9 architecture. The instance features AWS Neoverse-V3 processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, delivering 64 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading. It is equipped with 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per core. For high-throughput local I/O requirements, the server bundles 3,800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 34 Gbps. Hardware acceleration via GPUs is not included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel throughput and high memory efficiency. In CPU-focused benchmarks, the instance achieves top-tier results in Geekbench multi-core processing (30,301.0) and Clang software compilation (103,819.0), complemented by strong multi-core stress-ng performance (128,256.4). The memory subsystem exhibits top-tier performance in cached small-block reads (9,194.14 GB/sec) and PassMark memory operations, alongside strong uncached large-block throughput (347.08 GB/sec read, 163.23 GB/sec write). Transactional throughput is high, with Redis SET operations reaching 181.85 million operations per second and PassMark database operations placing in the top 10%. Conversely, single-core stress-ng tests and CPU-based LLM inference fall within average tiers.

The 64 dedicated physical cores deliver high compute density per instance, avoiding hyperthreading resource contention. Qualitative cost efficiency is pronounced for workloads optimized for ARMv9 instruction sets that leverage both the 34 Gbps networking baseline and the 3,800 GB local NVMe SSD capacity. Workloads relying on x86 AVX extensions or GPU hardware acceleration will face constraints. The server is well suited for high-transaction relational and NoSQL databases, in-memory caching systems such as Redis, large-scale CI/CD build environments, and data ingestion pipelines requiring fast local scratch disks.
description: Amazon Web Services m9gd.16xlarge is a general-purpose, arm64-based cloud instance powered by AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V3 processors running at 3.3 GHz. Configured on the Nitro System, it delivers 64 dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, paired with 256 GB of system RAM, 3,800 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, and 34 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. In empirical benchmarks, the platform demonstrates top-tier multi-core computing and memory subsystem performance, achieving top-decile results in Clang software compilation, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, PassMark database transactions, and Redis SET throughput reaching 181.85 million operations per second. While lacking hardware GPU accelerators and x86 vector extensions, its dedicated Neoverse core density offers high qualitative compute and I/O efficiency for ARM-native architectures. The instance is suited for high-throughput relational and NoSQL databases, in-memory caching layers, large-scale CI/CD build environments, and data-intensive web services requiring fast ephemeral storage.
